purpose: Inspect and configure ndpresponder IPv6 connectivity on the intended Linux host.
notes: Use network_status for read-only IPv6 addresses and routes; it does not configure tunnels, proxy NDP or advertise new addresses.
Confirm the real routed prefix, public IPv4, tunnel peer and interface names before applying the existing scripts. Never use documentation example prefixes on a live interface.
Keep native routes, Docker/CNI tracking and existing responder services intact; do not start duplicate responders.
purpose_zh: 查看 Linux IPv6 地址和路由，并排查现有 NDP responder 部署。
notes_zh: network_status 仅查询 IPv6 地址和路由，不创建隧道、不启用 NDP 代理、不宣告地址。
执行原有脚本前核对真实路由前缀、公网 IPv4、隧道对端和接口名，不将示例地址直接配置到真实网卡。
保留现有路由、Docker/CNI 跟踪及 responder 服务，不重复启动同一代理。
